approval_gate: Nolan approves every exact post. Silence is not approval.
cadence: per AI feature shipped, plus one standing reference post
first_installment_sketch: The three worked envelopes from directive sec 21: schema and evidence retrieval -> LLM synthesis -> binding verification; candidate generation -> LLM ranking -> policy, capability and budget validation; source extraction -> ambiguous interpretation -> schema validation plus evidence binding. First post is the reference diagram plus one real feature drawn through it. Constraint: the pattern is an explanatory envelope around the feature; the critic that reviews the feature cannot modify evidence, it can only produce objections, which the feature must answer or narrow the claim.
inputs: one AI feature: what it does, where intelligence is used
the deterministic stages before and after the intelligence
name: DETERMINISTIC ENVELOPE
outputs: one envelope diagram per AI feature
the standing reference post reused across features
purpose: Expose the DETERMINISTIC -> INTELLIGENCE -> DETERMINISTIC pattern on every AI feature so the technical story is 'bounded intelligence' rather than 'agentic'.
template: Every AI feature is drawn as DETERMINISTIC -> INTELLIGENCE -> DETERMINISTIC. Name the stages concretely. Hard constraint from the directive: the critic reviewing the feature cannot modify evidence; it can only produce objections, and the feature must answer them or narrow the claim. Uncertainty at any deterministic stage fails closed; it never becomes permission. The post states what the deterministic stages guarantee and what the intelligence is explicitly not trusted to do.
